title: Vaporesso Xros 3 Mini Vape Kit
description: The Vaporesso XROS 3 MINI is a simple-to-use yet extremely satisfying pod kit that offers fuss-free, RDTL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping in a sleek, lightweight and compact form factor. The Xros 3 MINI from Vaporesso is available in six stunning colours to suit your personal style and features a dazzling diamond-texture fascia that adds extra grippy comfort and an eye-catching aesthetic to the device. With its sleek, compact form-factor, the XROS 3 MINI kit feels lightweight yet solid in the hand and is discreet and light enough to carry everywhere. The Vaporesso Xros 3 MINI features an integrated 1000mAh battery that ensures reliable all-day vaping, assisted by super-fast USB Type-C charging. An illuminated neon strip at the base indicates how much charge your battery has left. To operate the Xros 3 MINI, you simply take a puff on the pod’s mouthpiece. The action is similar to taking a puff on a traditional cigarette, making the Xros 3 MINI pod kit ideal for newer vapers and recent ex-smokers. The Vaporesso Xros 3 MINI is compatible with all the disposable pods within the Xros family, but the kit includes the updated Xros Pod with an integrated 0.6ohm coil for a smooth and billowy RDTL (restricted direct-to-lung) experience ideal for use with 50/50 e-liquids. The kit is compatible with all Vaporesso Xros pods, so you have options to explore other vaping styles like MTL (mouth-to-lung) and DTL (direct-to-lung) with the same device. Vaporesso’s Corex heating technology and the pod’s coils’ unique morph-mesh structure ensures more rapid and even heating for improved flavour accuracy. The 2ml pods employ Vaporesso’s SSS Leak-Resistant Technology and a top filling port beneath the detachable cap to ensure refills are quick and clean. And when your coil begins to lose its flavour, simply replace with a new XROS pod . Sleek, stylish and super-compact, the new Vaporesso XROS 3 MINI Pod Kit delivers exceptionally satisfying vaping with the redesigned Xros fixed-coil pods. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Pods, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming' simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
